introduce: Start with your feet together and your arms by your sides, then jump up with your feet apart and your hands overhead. \n\nReturn to the start position then do the next rep. This exercise provides a full-body workout and works all your large muscle groups.
name: JUMPING JACKS

tips.text: Bend your arms to bring your hands over your head.
Start at a slow speed, then gradually increase the pace.
Your arms shouldn't be straight when you raise them above your head.
Inhale when your feet are apart, and exhale when pulling them back.
If you feel it's too easy, add weight on your ankles.
If you feel it's too easy, jump as high as you can.
Your back, glutes, abs, shoulders and calves all get involved.
It's a full body exercise to strengthen your cardiovascular system.

introduce:
Stand on the floor, then bend your left leg and grasp your ankle or toes to bring your left calf close to your left thigh. 

Hold this position for a few seconds, then change sides and repeat.

Your lifted knee should always go straight down, and your upper body should keep straight during the exercise.
name: QUAD STRETCH

tips.text: Please keep your chest open.
The knee of your lifted leg should always point straight toward the ground.
Please keep your upper body straight.
Exhale as you lift one foot up behind you and bring it towards your buttocks.
Inhale as you lower your foot back down to the ground.
This exercise works on your quadriceps.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your left knee forward and drop your right knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
Inhale deeply as you lower your body into the lunge position.
Exhale as you press your hips forward and feel the stretch in your legs.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

introduce:
Start in a push-up position. Bring your right knee forward and drop your left knee on the floor. 

Raise your upper body and put your hands on your waist. Then push your hips forward while keeping your upper body straight. 

Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes. Hold this position for a few seconds.
name: KNEELING LUNGE STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Please keep your upper body straight when pushing your hips forward.
Please do not arch your back.
Please make sure your front knee won’t go over your toes.
Inhale deeply as you lower your body into the lunge position.
Exhale as you press your hips forward and feel the stretch in your legs.
This exercise works on your hip flexors and thighs.

introduce: Place your arms at your sides and pretend to hold a skipping rope handle in each hand. \n\nJump and alternately land on the balls of your feet, rotating your wrists at the same time as if you were spinning a rope.
name: SKIPPING WITHOUT ROPE

tips.text: Your heels should not touch the ground during skipping.
Breathe in through your nose and out through your mouth at a regular pace.
This is a good exercise for your cardiovascular system.
It\'s a full-body workout that tones the muscle of your lower and upper body.

introduce: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart, chest up and shoulders back. Exhale, lift one knee up, and grab it with both hands.\n\nThen gently pull it towards your body as much as you can. Breathe naturally. Hold for a few seconds, switch sides and repeat.
name: STANDING KNEE TO CHEST

tips.text: Please keep your body straight when lifting your knee up.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Stand with your feet wide apart. 

Inhale to lengthen your spine and open your chest. Exhale slowly to hinge at your hips and fold your torso forward from your hips, keeping your back long. Place your hands on the floor.

Hold the position with deep, steady breaths. With each exhale, relax and allow your body to sink deeper.
name: WIDE LEGGED FORWARD FOLD

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please keep your back flat.
Tighten your abs.
Please squeeze your quadriceps and inner thighs.
You can slightly bend your knees if you feel it’s too hard.
Too hard? You can press your fingertips on a block or something similar.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to soften into the stretch.
This position stretches your inner thighs and hamstrings.
This position relieves tension in your lower back.

introduce:
Sit with the soles of your feet together. Draw your heels towards your hips, and press your knees down as much as possible. 

Place your hands in front of you, lean forward and lower your upper body as close to the ground as possible. Hold this position. 

Each time you exhale, try harder to reach for the floor with your body.

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.
name: BUTTERFLY POSE

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Press your knees down as much as possible.
Breathe deeply.
Keep your sit bones down.
You should feel the stretch in your thighs.
This position can open up your hips and thighs.
This position helps stretch your thighs.

introduce:
Sit with your legs extended in front of you. Bend your right leg with your right foot close to your left thigh. 

Lean your upper body forward to touch the ground. Hold this position. 

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.
name: STANDARD SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch on the back of your left thigh.
This exercise can stretch your thighs and hamstrings.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Sit with your legs extended in front of you. Bend your left leg with your left foot close to your right thigh. 

Lean your upper body forward to touch the ground. Hold this position. 

Please note
You may need to practice several times to perfect your form.
name: STANDARD SITTING HAMSTRING STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
You should feel a stretch on the back of your right thigh.
This exercise can stretch your thighs and hamstrings.
This exercise can help relieve lower back pain.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Stand in front of the wall. Put your hands on the wall, and swing your left leg from side to side. Please swing your leg as high as possible.
name: SINGLE LEG SWINGS LEFT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale gently as you swing your leg to one side
Inhale as the leg swings across to the other side.
This position stretches your inner thighs and hamstrings.

introduce: Stand in front of the wall. Put your hands on the wall, and swing your right leg from side to side. Please swing your leg as high as possible.
name: SINGLE LEG SWINGS RIGHT

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Keep your back straight.
Exhale gently as you swing your leg to one side
Inhale as the leg swings across to the other side.
This position stretches your inner thighs and hamstrings.

introduce: Lie on your back with your arms by your sides. Lift your legs until your thighs are perpendicular to the floor. Open your legs to your sides as possible as you can. Return and repeat.\n\nInhale when you open your legs and exhale when you bring them back. This exercise stretches your inner thighs.
name: LYING LEG ABDUCTION

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please do it slowly to feel the stretch in your inner thighs.
Inhale when you open your legs and exhale when you bring them back.
You should feel the stretch in your inner thighs.
This exercise stretches your inner thighs.

introduce:
Shift your weight to the right, bend your right knee and sit your hips back. Stretch your left leg with your toes toward your body. 

Bend your body towards your left leg. Return and repeat. Try to get your body closer and closer to your leg every time you bend your body.

Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up. This exercise stretches your hamstrings and inner thigh.
name: DYNAMIC LEFT LEG STRETCH

tips.text: Please pull your toes towards your body.
Keep your back flat.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and inner thigh.

introduce:
Shift your weight to the left, bend your left knee and sit your hips back. Stretch your right leg with your toes toward your body. 

Bend your body towards your right leg. Return and repeat. Try to get your body closer and closer to your leg every time you bend your body.

Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up. This exercise stretches your hamstrings and inner thigh.
name: DYNAMIC RIGHT LEG STRETCH

tips.text: Please pull your toes towards your body.
Keep your back flat.
Please keep your extended leg straight.
Exhale on the way down, and inhale on the way up.
This exercise stretches your hamstrings and inner thigh.

introduce:
Start on your hands and knees in a tabletop position. Open your knees and lower your pelvis until you feel a mild stretch. Turn your toes outward to the sides, so the big toe edge of your feet is on the floor. 

Exhale as you lower your chest towards the floor. Inhale as you slowly move your body forward. Then exhale, ease back. 

Gently rock your hips forward and back. Inhale to lengthen your spine and create space in your body, and exhale to relax deeper into the stretch.
name: DYNAMIC FROG POSE

tips.text: Inhale to lengthen your spine and exhale to deepen the stretch in your hips and groin.
Please do this on a mat.
Breathe naturally.
Please keep your core tight.
Please keep your tailbone tucked down.
Please pull your toes toward your body.
This exercise stretches your inner thighs, groin and hips.
